problems.text: Checks exist only in the untracked prototype, written by a langchain model loop, so no coding agent can write, test or store one through kmctl
Nothing reruns a stored check only when its claim or the files it reads change, so every pass would run every check
A check can hold without testing its claim (25 of 161 in the prototype's pilot noticed no change), and nothing keeps such a check out of the store
A check writer shown too few lines guesses code it never saw, the prototype writer's main failure, and cannot run a draft before storing it

goals.text: A coding agent, using its harness's own model, writes, tries and stores a claim's check through `kmctl audit checks`, with no model call in kmctl and base kmctl's four dependencies unchanged
Stored checks rerun with no model, only when their claim or the files they read changed
Only checks that notice a change to the code they read are stored

outcomes.change: Base kmctl holds the step DSL and a model-free runner, with code and query steps behind `kmctl[audit]`
outcomes.checked_by: `new:tests/test_claims_steps.py` (each step holds and fails on a fixture git repository; markdown, `.okf/` and untracked files are never read; a code step tests presence only; with ast-grep-py and jmespath hidden, code and query steps report skipped and the other five run)

outcomes.change: Each claim comes with the lines around its anchors and the check instructions
outcomes.checked_by: `new:tests/test_claims_lines.py` (a claim naming a path, a flag and a Python name gets lines around each; a claim naming nothing gets keyword windows from its concept's sources; Python definitions resolve without the extra)

outcomes.change: Mutation testing marks a holding check weak when it notices no change or matched only comments
outcomes.checked_by: `new:tests/test_claims_mutate.py` (a grep on a comment is weak, a code step on the condition kills its mutants, unparsable mutants are dropped, nothing is written to disk)

outcomes.change: The store keeps each check's claim, steps, reads and last run with step detail, and reruns a check only when its claim or reads change
outcomes.checked_by: `new:tests/test_claims_check_store.py` (the new user_version steps open a fresh database and a claims-only one; an unchanged repository reruns nothing; an edited read file, a newly matching glob file and a changed claim each rerun only their check; a mutation score is reused until its key moves; a check's claim, steps and last step detail read back by check id)

outcomes.change: `kmctl audit checks` lets an agent take claims with `todo`, test drafts with `try`, store checks with `submit` and rerun them with `run`
outcomes.checked_by: `new:tests/test_checks_cli.py` (the fixture-repository flow in the intent; submit refuses a weak check naming its survivors, a failing check without drift, a stale claim id, a malformed answer and a code step without the extra, each with one stderr line and the fix, keeping good answers in the same file; try writes nothing; run exits 0 when a check fails; no tracked or unignored file changes; no verb opens a network connection) and `tests/test_help.py`

outcomes.change: A decision record, the manifesto, the architecture overview and the command reference describe checks, the extra and the weak bar
outcomes.checked_by: `kmctl check`, strict OKF validation in the pre-commit hooks, and the docs tests
